title: My profile
subtitle: How you appear inside the panel, and where people can find you
display_name_hint: Leave empty to show the account name. A display name is shown alongside it, not instead of it.
avatar_readonly_hint: The avatar cannot be changed here yet — uploading one needs the media permission, which self-service does not carry.
links_hint: Every link is optional. Give the full URL starting with https://, and empty it to remove the link. Each must point at its own platform's domain.
error_name_long: The name is too long (255 characters maximum).
error_display_name_long: The display name is too long (255 characters maximum).
error_bio_long: The biography is too long (1000 characters maximum).
error_link_shape: Give a full URL starting with http:// or https://
